Those seashells must have REALLY pissed him off


Aaron Rupar (@atrupar)

COLLINS: Do you really think that Comey was threatening your life with that post?

TRUMP: Well if anybody knows anything about crime, they know '86' is a mob term for 'kill 'em.' You ever see the movies?

Video
  





— https://nitter.net/atrupar/status/2049556592568213612#m
In the last couple of hours, the rapidly declining Trump claimed he’s fit enough to be an astronaut and mixed up Ukraine and Iran. He must be removed.
Is there anyone out there whose energy costs have come down 50%, as promised?
Gas prices are at the highest point in three years TODAY. Notice how it's completely missing from corporate media as they talk about "staged," King Charles, and Trump's ballroom?

There’s a report that raises serious questions about what was actually happening inside Donald Trump’s White House. And if the reporting is accurate, it may help explain some of the erratic, chaotic behavior that defined that environment. substack.davidpakman.com/p/t…
Trump’s ballroom can only accommodate 1000 people, and the WHCD is 2000-2500 people. Can someone explain how his ballroom “solves” the problem from this past weekend?
We’re officially in the top 10 on Substack. Sitting at #7. If you value independent coverage, subscribing is the best FREE way to support the show. Subscribe at substack.davidpakman.com

The idea that Saturday’s shooting was staged to help Trump’s approval falls SUPER FLAT when you consider Trump ACTUALLY being shot in the ear bumped him HALF A POINT in the polls. We’re supposed to believe a shooting on a different floor of a hotel that goes nowhere near him is going to help his approval?

Some are suggesting the Republican obsession today with the shooting PROVING we need Trump’s ballroom is proof that the shooting was staged. What it proves that these lunatics won’t hesitate to use ANYTHING for their own harebrained priorities.

Both Donald and Melania Trump have now called for Jimmy Kimmel to be fired for jokes. What happened to the 1st Amendment? Freedom of the press? Free speech?

I think this will backfire. The American people realize that, politics aside, this is a dangerous path to go down, even if Trump and MAGA don’t care.

Trump can’t even admit “yes, in the rush out of the WHCD, I tripped. It was chaos.” He has to lie and say “no, I didn’t fall down.” He was “asked to get closer to the ground.” Anyone who watches the video knows that’s not what happened.

The more that right wingers talk about the ballroom, the more it's going to seem staged to many people. Jumping from “security should have been better in the lobby” to “build Trump’s scam bribe ballroom” is just ridiculous
A huge win for independent media

Update from DC re WHCD shooting

Video
I've just heard about the shooting at the White House Correspondents Dinner. I was at that location earlier but am not there and am fine. The situation seems absolutely insane.

Let’s hold up a second. Yes, Trump fell asleep again in the Oval Office. Yes, he’s unfit for the job. Yes, he’s quickly losing his cognitive abilities. Yes, he should be removed immediately. But this image that is spreading virally of Trump bonking his head on the Resolute Desk is AI.
Remember Trump’s first term, the quaint one, where he lovingly suggested people inject themselves with bleach to clean themselves out of COVID germs? Simpler times.
New substack just dropped ⬇️ substack.davidpakman.com/p/w…

NURSE, GET THE BEDPAN! Seriously, what is happening at the White House?

Video
DAMN: Trump did NOT LIKE this one
This broke Trump’s brain
WOW: Melania F***ING HATES Trump
Trump posts UNHINGED THREAT in middle of night
Trump DANGEROUSLY DISORIENTED in front of the King
OH NO: The shooter WASN’T THE SHOOTER?
The real King embarrasses fake king Trump
This is how people get fooled by fake common ground #shorts
Don't worry, they didn't burn down the White House this time #shorts
Imagine ending maternity leave for this #shorts
